ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for matrices.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: Matrix addition requires the same dimensions.
For $AB$ to exist, the number of columns of $A$ must equal the number of rows of $B$.
Matrix multiplication is generally not commutative. When an inverse exists, $A^{-1}A=I$.
